profile.notice_section_1_intro: Important: Account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone! Before submitting your request, please ensure you have completed the following:
profile.notice_section_1_item_1: • Backup all personal data, messages, favorites, and other information you wish to retain.
profile.notice_section_1_item_2: • Settle all account-related fees (unpaid subscriptions, pending refunds, account balance, etc.). Deletion cannot proceed with outstanding obligations.
profile.notice_section_1_item_3: • Disconnect third-party platform bindings (WeChat, Google login, etc.) and cancel auto-renewal or recurring payment services.
profile.notice_section_1_item_4: • If this is a corporate/organization account or minor's account, complete required guardian confirmation and official documentation verification.
profile.notice_section_2_title: II. Rights and Data After Deletion
profile.notice_section_2_intro: Once your account is deleted, you will experience the following irreversible consequences:
profile.notice_section_2_item_1: • You will no longer be able to log in to Linx AI products or related services. Re-registering with the same email/phone will create a new account with no connection to the original.
profile.notice_section_2_item_2: • All account data will be permanently deleted or anonymized (in compliance with Personal Information Protection Law), including but not limited to personal profile, transaction records, points, memberships, vouchers, etc., and cannot be recovered.
profile.notice_section_2_item_3: • All followed official accounts and friend relationships will be automatically removed, and others will not be able to contact you through this account.
profile.notice_section_2_item_4: • Legal responsibilities and behavior records prior to deletion will not be waived or reduced due to account deletion.
profile.notice_section_3_condition: Deletion Conditions: No outstanding disputes, no ongoing complaints/investigations/litigation, and all preparation items in the 'Important Notice' section above have been completed.
profile.notice_section_3_step_2: 2. Once the request is completed, the account will be officially deleted.
profile.delete_account_notice: Before requesting account deletion, please review the following impact:
profile.delete_account_data_removed: All personal data including device bindings, agents, and voiceprints will be permanently removed.
profile.delete_account_irreversible: This action is irreversible and you will not be able to recover your account or data.
profile.delete_account_desc: If you are sure you want to continue, confirm below and the deletion will be processed immediately.
